- Overestimate early in the horizon; true values often rise faster than model suggests.  
- Underestimate after sharp spikes; model fails to capture post-peak volatility or mean reversion.  
- Exhibit persistent upward bias; model drifts higher than actual mean, especially in mid-to-late horizon.  
- Lag in response to recent price spikes; model reacts too slowly to new data.  
- Overfit to recent trends; model ignores structural mean reversion or seasonal patterns.  
- Underestimate volatility in late horizon; model flattens out too early despite rising uncertainty.
